description: Create a calendar event. Required: subject, start_date_time, end_date_time. Optional: location, description, who_id, what_id, is_all_day_event, owner_id, fields. Datetimes must be ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-01-09T14:30:00Z"); all-day events accept plain dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date_time.description: End (required) — ISO 8601 datetime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events

start_date_time.description: Start (required) — ISO 8601 datetime (see tool description for an example), or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events

what_id.description: Account or Opportunity ID to relate

who_id.description: Contact or Lead ID to invite/relate

name: salesforce_create_event
